text:
Maria - CS: Quick heads-up: patch window tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC to address flaky VPC auth handshakes that are causing webhook retries for new onboardings. Draft customer note below — need fast review. thread_ts=2419004321

Maria - CS: Draft:
"Hi — we are applying a targeted fix tonight (23:00–00:30 UTC) to resolve intermittent VPC authentication handshakes that can trigger webhook retries during onboarding. Impact: some onboarding attempts and webhook deliveries may be delayed or retried while we perform the fix. We do not expect data loss. Mitigation: queued events will be reprocessed automatically; please allow up to 30 minutes for retries. If you require an immediate onboarding for a launch, reply and we will arrange a manual bypass. We will send a brief RCA when the maintenance completes." :email:

Jamal - Eng: ACK. Patch is a short auth-proxy config flip + DB pool tweak. Reversible. We will monitor retry queue and metrics. :white_check_mark:

Alex - PM: Add note: "Dedicated or Private deployments unaffected unless customers route webhooks through our hosted proxy." Priya — flag renewal-risk accounts for 1:1 outreach.

Priya - CS: On it. Pulling renewal-risk list now; will prepare 1:1 templates for top 15 and custom exec notes for top 3. :mag_right:

Sohail - SRE: SRE will open a bridge at 22:45 UTC and watch alerts. Threshold: webhook error rate >2x baseline. I will post to #incidents if we cross it.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: fix/vpc-auth-2026-03-22 at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z by jamal (change-id: e4f8c2).

Jamal - Eng: Technical note for CS: we honor exponential backoff up to 10 attempts. Recommend customers extend webhook TTLs for the window if they use strict TTLs.

Maria - CS: Added TTL guidance to draft. Also pausing automated onboarding reminders for impacted templates per Alex.

Priya - CS: Segmentation sheet created and top accounts tagged. Sending 1:1 drafts in thread.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: fix/vpc-auth-2026-03-22 (e4f8c2).

Sohail - SRE: Small transient bump observed at deploy +1m (~1.2x baseline), under threshold. Monitoring closely.

Jamal - Eng: Patch applied and toggled live. Watching DB pool and auth proxy latencies. Rollback path ~12 minutes if needed.

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: fix/vpc-auth-2026-03-22 (e4f8c2) — SUCCESS.

Sohail - SRE: Metrics stable and baseline held for 15m. Bridge closing. Will publish short RCA in #incidents shortly.

Maria - CS: Customer messages delivered at 22:52 UTC to impacted segments. Monitoring replies and routing manual requests to Priya.

Priya - CS: Received manual replay request from BrightHouse Inc — handling now. Noted one renewal concern; escalating to AE.

Maria - CS: Post-deploy rule: if >1% failed onboards by 01:00 UTC, open follow-up RCA with affected tenant list and CS action items (credits, manual replays). Priya — please have templates ready.

Priya - CS: Templates + replay checklist prepared; linking to doc in the RCA thread after bridge post.

Maria - CS: Closing thread. Will attach RCA and tenant impact list when published. Thanks all :pray:
